description: Continuous CRO Event Taxonomy, Conversion Funnel, and Telemetry Specification for the Rank Kiwi Marketing Website.

primary.name: webstore_click
primary.description: User clicks an installation or Chrome Web Store outbound CTA to visit the extension listing with direct install intent.
primary.attributionBoundary: Outbound intent measured on-site; actual installation requires Chrome Web Store client telemetry.

secondary.name: docs_click
secondary.description: User navigates into product documentation, quickstarts, or troubleshooting workflows, indicating high activation interest.

secondary.name: outlier_score_view
secondary.description: User visits the Outlier Score methodology guide to understand how creator benchmarking and anomaly detection works.

secondary.name: exports_view
secondary.description: User navigates to export and CSV/JSON documentation to evaluate workflow fit with spreadsheets or client reporting.

secondary.name: comparison_view
secondary.description: User views an in-depth head-to-head comparison page to evaluate Rank Kiwi vs alternative tools.

secondary.name: alternatives_view
secondary.description: User views an alternatives guide exploring competitor tools and Rank Kiwi's role.

secondary.name: best_of_view
secondary.description: User reads a category evaluation or best-of guide to choose tools for a specific social research workflow.

micro.name: faq_expand
micro.description: User toggles open an FAQ accordion question to resolve an objection or question.

micro.name: workflow_step_click
micro.description: User clicks through the 3-step interactive product workflow carousel (Profile -> Scan -> Sort).

micro.name: scroll_depth
micro.description: User reaches 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100% of document scroll depth on long-form content pages.

micro.name: citation_copy
micro.description: User copies an academic or research citation snippet or code block.

micro.name: social_click
micro.description: User clicks outbound link to developer profile, GitHub, YouTube, or LinkedIn.

micro.name: navigation_click
micro.description: User clicks header, mobile menu, or footer navigational links.

dimensions.event: Event name matching the defined taxonomy (e.g., 'webstore_click', 'website_cta_click')
dimensions.page_slug: Normalized URL slug or path without leading/trailing slashes (e.g. 'instagram-analytics', 'compare/rank-kiwi-vs-sort-feed')
dimensions.experiment_id: Optional identifier for active A/B test (e.g. 'exp_hp_hero_cta_v1')
dimensions.href: Destination URL of the clicked element
dimensions.text: Sanitized inner text of the interaction element
dimensions.timestamp: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the client interaction

funnel.name: Organic / Referral / Direct Landing
funnel.measurement: Page view recorded with referrer, campaign UTMs, and landing page slug.

funnel.name: Content Engagement
funnel.measurement: Scroll depth milestone (25%, 50%), carousel interaction, or time on page > 15s.

funnel.name: Product Understanding
funnel.measurement: Deep scroll (75%), workflow carousel completion, FAQ accordion expansion, or methodology exploration.

funnel.name: CTA Interaction
funnel.measurement: Interaction with primary or secondary CTA ('website_cta_click').

funnel.name: Chrome Web Store Visit (Outbound Intent)
funnel.measurement: Deepest on-site conversion: click to Chrome Web Store with extension ID ('webstore_click').

funnel.name: Extension Installation (External)
funnel.measurement: External action on Chrome Web Store listing (measured via developer dashboard / extension install event).

funnel.name: Product Activation (Product-Level)
funnel.measurement: First creator analysis run locally in extension on Instagram Reels or YouTube channel catalog.
